text: Separating non-transferable reputation tokens from fungible collateral tokens closes the governance-capture pathway that single-token systems expose, in which voting power can be purchased or borrowed.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Governance as a Product (GaaP): A Reputation-Weighted Institutional Architecture for Autonomous AI Agent Governance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6886078

abstract: Non-transferable reputation tokens are separated from fungible, priceable col- lateral tokens. This separation closes the governance-capture pathway that single-token systems expose, in which voting power can be purchased or borrowed
